paite: Huan kumpipa David in mipi tengteng kiang ah, "Pathian telkhiak ka tapa Solomon anaupang lai in bangmah athei nai kei a, asep ding lah athupi ngal a, tempul mihing a ding ahi kei a, TOUPA Pathian a ding ahi zaw hi.
heading: Tempul Lamna Dia Thilpiakte
english: David the king said to all the assembly, “Solomon my son, whom alone God has chosen, is yet young and tender, and the work is great; for the palace is not for man, but for Yahweh God.

paite: Huchi in ka Pathian inn a ding in adangka-eng lam thil a ding in dangka-engte, dangkasik lam thil a ding in, dangkasik, dal lam thil a ding in dal, sik lam thil a ding in sik, sing lam thil a ding in sing theih tawk in ka na kisa khinta a, azepna ding onik suang, suang kilawm, asilh ding suang kilawm chi tuamtuam leh suangmantam chi chih leh suangpak suang tampite ka pe khinta hi.
english: Now I have prepared with all my might for the house of my God the gold for the things of gold, the silver for the things of silver, the bronze for the things of bronze, iron for the things of iron, and wood for the things of wood, also onyx stones, stones to be set, stones for inlaid work of various colors, all kinds of precious stones, and marble stones in abundance.

paite: Huai kia lou leng ka Pathian inn ka deihsak mahmah a, keimah sum dangka-eng leh dangkate leng, inn siangthou a dia ka na kisaksa tengteng chih louh, ka Pathian inn a ding in ka pia hi, huai tuh baang zutna ding in ophir dangka-eng,
english: In addition, because I have set my affection on the house of my God, since I have a treasure of my own of gold and silver, I give it to the house of my God, over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house:

paite: dangka-eng talent sangthum leh dangkasik siangthou talent sangsagih, azatna lam tuamtuam a misiamte zat ding in, dangka-eng zatna ding a dangka-engte.
english: even three thousand talents of gold, of the gold of Ophir, and seven thousand talents of refined silver, with which to overlay the walls of the houses;

paite: Dangkasik zatna ding a dangkasikte ahi. Tuni in TOUPA a ding a kipaktak a pe phal kuakua na om ua?" achi hi.
english: of gold for the things of gold, and of silver for the things of silver, and for all kinds of work to be made by the hands of artisans. Who then offers willingly to consecrate himself today to Yahweh?”

paite: Huchi in inkuan makaipente, Israel nam heutute, sangkhat heutute leh zakhat heutute, kumpipa nasemte heutute toh kipaktak in apia uhi.
english: Then the princes of the fathers’ households, and the princes of the tribes of Israel, and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, with the rulers over the king’s work, offered willingly;

paite: Pathian inn lamna ding dangka-eng talent sangnga leh darik singkhat, dangkasik talent singkhat leh dal talent singkhat-le-sanggiat, sik talent nuaikhat apia uhi.
english: and they gave for the service of God’s house of gold five thousand talents and ten thousand darics, of silver ten thousand talents, of bronze eighteen thousand talents, and of iron one hundred thousand talents.

paite: Suangmantam neite'n TOUPA sum koihkhawmna a Gershon mi Jehiel kep ding in akoih uhi.
english: People with whom precious stones were found gave them to the treasure of Yahweh’s house, under the hand of Jehiel the Gershonite.

paite: Huchi in mipite akipak mahmah ua, lungsim mun khat pu a kipaktak a TOUPA apiak ziak un, kumpipa David in leng nop sak petmah in nuam asa hi.
english: Then the people rejoiced, because they offered willingly, because with a perfect heart they offered willingly to Yahweh; and David the king also rejoiced with great joy.

paite: Huchi in David in mipi tengteng ma ah TOUPA kiang ah kipahthu agen hi,
heading: David In Pathian Apahtawi
english: Therefore David blessed Yahweh before all the assembly; and David said, “You are blessed, Yahweh, the God of Israel our father, forever and ever.

paite: "Aw TOUPA, ka pu uh Israel' Pathian, tangtawn in phat in om hen. Aw TOUPA, thupina, thilhihtheihna, pahtawina, zohna, lalna nang a ahi a, lei leh van a om tengteng nang a ahi. Aw TOUPA, gam nang a ahi a, mi tengteng atungnungpen na hi.
english: Yours, Yahweh, is the greatness, the power, the glory, the victory, and the majesty! For all that is in the heavens and on the earth is yours. Yours is the kingdom, Yahweh, and you are exalted as head above all.

paite: Hauhsakna leh pahtawina na kiang a kipan ahi, bangkim tung ah thu na nei a, na khut ah thilhihtheihna a-om a, mi tengteng hih thupina leh hatna piaktheihna na khut ah a-om hi.
english: Both riches and honor come from you, and you rule over all! In your hand is power and might! It is in your hand to make great, and to give strength to all!

paite: 'Huchi in ka Pathian uh kipahthu ka hon hilh ua, na min thupi ka phat uhi.'
english: Now therefore, our God, we thank you and praise your glorious name.

paite: "Himahleh kua ahia ka hih a, ka mite leng kua ahia ahih ua, hiaite kipaktak a ka hon lat theih mahmah uh? Thil tengteng na kiang a kipan a pawt ahi ua, nang a hon pe nawn lel ka hi uhi.
english: But who am I, and what is my people, that we should be able to offer so willingly as this? For all things come from you, and we have given you of your own.

paite: Ka pi-le-pute uh bang in kou zaw na ma ah mikhual, mite kiang a om sam bang ka hi ua; leitung adamsung nite zaw limliap bang lel ahi a, lamet ding himhim a-om kei hi.
english: For we are strangers before you and foreigners, as all our fathers were. Our days on the earth are as a shadow, and there is no remaining.

paite: TOUPA ka Pathian uh, na min siangthou ding a inn ka hon lamsak ding a hiai thil ka na kisakna tengteng uh nangmah khutsuak ahi a, nang a vek ahi.
english: Yahweh our God, all this store that we have prepared to build you a house for your holy name comes from your hand, and is all your own.

paite: Ka Pathian, nang lungtangte na enchian sek a, diktatnate na kipahpih nak chih leng ka thei hi. Ke'n zaw lungsim taktak in hiai thil tengteng kipak mahmah in ka hon lan ahi, hiai lai a kipak mahmah a na kiang a hon lan mite ka muh in ka kipak mahmah hi.
english: I know also, my God, that you try the heart and have pleasure in uprightness. As for me, in the uprightness of my heart I have willingly offered all these things. Now I have seen with joy your people, who are present here, offer willingly to you.

paite: AW TOUPA, ka pu uh Abraham, Isak, Israel' Pathian, na mite'n hichibang lungsim aput gige theihna ding un alungsimte uh nang a ding in hihkip inla;
english: Yahweh, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Israel, our fathers, keep this desire forever in the thoughts of the heart of your people, and prepare their heart for you;

paite: huan ka tapa Solomon na thupiakte, na thu theihsakte, na dante zui a, huaite tengteng hih ding leh ka kisakkholhna inn lam ding in lungsim hoihkim pusak in," David in achi hi.
english: and give to Solomon my son a perfect heart, to keep your commandments, your testimonies, and your statutes, and to do all these things, and to build the palace, for which I have made provision.”

paite: David in mipi tengteng kiang ah, "Khai le, TOUPA na Pathian uh phat un," achi a, huchi in mipi tengteng in TOUPA, apipute uh Pathian aphat ua, akun ua, TOUPA leh kumpipa abia uhi.
english: Then David said to all the assembly, “Now bless Yahweh your God!” All the assembly blessed Yahweh, the God of their fathers, and bowed down their heads and prostrated themselves before Yahweh and the king.

paite: Azing in TOUPA kiang ah kithoihna ding leh TOUPA kiang a halmang thillat ding in bawngtal sangkhat leh belam sangkhat leh belamnou sangkhat, adawn ding uh thillat toh Israelte tengteng a ding in kithoihna tampi alan uhi.
english: They sacrificed sacrifices to Yahweh and offered burnt offerings to Yahweh on the next day after that day, even one thousand bulls, one thousand rams, and one thousand lambs, with their drink offerings and sacrifices in abundance for all Israel,

paite: Huchi in huai ni in TOUPA ma ah nuamsatak in ane ua, a-om chiat uhi. David tapa Solomon bel kumpipa ding in abawl tuan nawn ua, TOUPA milian ding in sathau anilh ua, huan, Zadok bel siampu ding in.
english: and ate and drank before Yahweh on that day with great gladness. They made Solomon the son of David king the second time, and anointed him before Yahweh to be prince, and Zadok to be priest.

paite: Huchi in Solomon TOUPA laltutphah ah apa David sik in kumpipa in atuta a, lamzangtak in a-om a; huan Israelte tengteng in athu azui uhi.
english: Then Solomon sat on the throne of Yahweh as king instead of David his father, and prospered; and all Israel obeyed him.

paite: Huan heutute tengteng leh mihat hangsante leh kumpipa David tapa dang tengtengte kumpipa Solomon lak ah akipia uh.
english: All the princes, the mighty men, and also all of the sons of King David submitted themselves to Solomon the king.

paite: TOUPA'N Israelte tengteng mitmuh in nakpitak in Solomon ahih thupi a, Israel gam a ama a kumpipate lak ah kuamah in atan ngei louh uh, kumpipa hihna thupi mahmah atangta hi.
english: Yahweh magnified Solomon exceedingly in the sight of all Israel, and gave to him such royal majesty as had not been on any king before him in Israel.

paite: Jesse tapa David in Israelte tengteng tung ah vai ahawm hi.
heading: David Vaihawm Hun Leh Asihna
english: Now David the son of Jesse reigned over all Israel.

paite: Israelte tung a avaihawm sung kum sawmli ahi; Hebron ah kum sagih vai ahawm a, Jerusalem ah kum sawmthum-le-thum vai ahawm hi.
english: The time that he reigned over Israel was forty years; he reigned seven years in Hebron, and he reigned thirty-three years in Jerusalem.

paite: Upa tekkun a dam in, hausatak leh pahtawinate tang in asi a; asik in atapa Solomon in vai ahawm hi.
english: He died at a good old age, full of days, riches, and honor; and Solomon his son reigned in his place.

paite: Ngai in, kumpipa David tanchin atung a kipan atawp tan in, zawlnei Samuel laibu, zawlnei Nathan laibu leh zawlnei Gad laibute ah atuang hi.
english: Now the acts of David the king, first and last, behold, they are written in the history of Samuel the seer, and in the history of Nathan the prophet, and in the history of Gad the seer,

paite: Avaihawm thute, athilhihtheihdan tengtengte, amah leh Israelte tung leh gam tengteng tung a thil hong omdante toh.
english: with all his reign and his might, and the events that involved him, Israel, and all the kingdoms of the lands.
